method: Manual rewrite of the complete 欠 boundary: the independent card teaches the common lexical meaning owe, while every structural use and the root's visual form use the concrete yawn pictograph.

roots.reason: The common independent meaning is owe/lack, while the reusable graph depicts an open-mouthed person yawning or exhaling. The concrete yawn image explains the many breath, mouth, sound, and emotion compounds better than the abstract adjective deficient.
